purpose: Teach: よせ/想う/絶好調/道端/窮屈/ハメ/等しく/踏み出し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、噂話はよせって、ベテランの先輩が仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, drop the gossip—even the veteran baristas say so.
lines.style: Gentle but firm correction. Warm tone underneath. Steady eye contact. A reminder that comes from care, not judgment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、亡くなったご家族を想う気持ちでお茶を召し上がってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was drinking their tea thinking about their family. Did you notice?
lines.style: Soft, reflective. Pause before the question. Not accusatory—genuinely curious if Aoi saw what she saw. Tender attention to detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの売れ行き、絶好調ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu is doing really well, you know. Everyone's ordering it.
lines.style: Warm observation, slight lift of pride. Natural pace. The pleased tone of someone noticing good news and wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、道端の桜並木、満開だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The cherry trees along the street are in full bloom right now.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Gentle, almost to herself. The tone of someone noticing beauty and wanting to mark the moment with someone else.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の制服、ちょっと窮屈に感じる時があるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The shop uniform feels a little tight sometimes, doesn't it?
lines.style: Light, knowing wryness. Self-aware without complaining. The small admission of someone comfortable enough to say the obvious thing out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、繁忙期は早朝から店に出るハメになるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: During the busy season we end up starting before dawn, don't we?
lines.style: Tired understanding, wry acceptance. Not bitter—just naming what is. Slow enough to feel the weight of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様には等しく丁寧に対応しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We need to treat every customer with the same care and attention, you know.
lines.style: Gentle directive, but grounded. Not a lecture—a shared principle. Warm and steady, like a reminder to herself too.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、お店としても新しい一歩を踏み出した気分ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu feels like the shop took a real step forward. A new beginning for us.
lines.style: Genuine warmth and quiet pride. Reflective close. Soft landing—the tone of someone feeling something settle into place.
